mapper.insert: insert into player_run_session (member_id, activity_id, topic_id, run_state, elapsed_seconds, saved_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{activityId}, #{topicId}, 'PAUSED', #{elapsedSeconds}, #{savedAt}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update run_state = if(values(saved_at) >= saved_at, values(run_state), run_state), elapsed_seconds = if(values(saved_at) >= saved_at, values(elapsed_seconds), elapsed_seconds), update_time = if(values(saved_at) >= saved_at, values(update_time), update_time), saved_at = if(values(saved_at) >= saved_at, values(saved_at), saved_at)
mapper.sql: where member_id = #{memberId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and topic_id = #{topicId}
mapper.select: select activity_id as activityId, topic_id as topicId, run_state as runState, elapsed_seconds as elapsedSeconds, saved_at as savedAt from player_run_session limit 1
mapper.update:
update player_run_session set run_state = 'ENDED', elapsed_seconds = 0, saved_at = #{savedAt}, update_time = now()
and saved_at <= #{savedAt}
mapper.select: select r.activity_id as activityId, r.topic_id as topicId, r.run_state as runState, r.elapsed_seconds as elapsedSeconds, r.saved_at as savedAt, coalesce(a.name, t.name) as title, coalesce(nullif(a.img_url, ''), t.img_url) as cover from player_run_session r join cms_topic t on t.id = r.topic_id and t.del_flag = 0 left join cms_activity a on r.activity_id > 0 and a.id = r.activity_id where r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.run_state = 'PAUSED' and ( (r.activity_id > 0 and a.id is not null and a.del_flag = 0 and a.cancel_time is null and (a.end_date is null or a.end_date >= curdate()) and exists (select 1 from cms_registration g where g.member_id = r.member_id and g.owner_type = 2 and g.owner_id = r.activity_id and g.registration_status = 2)) or (r.activity_id = 0 and exists (select 1 from cms_registration g where g.member_id = r.member_id and g.owner_type = 1 and g.owner_id = r.topic_id and g.registration_status = 2 and (g.expires_at is null or g.expires_at > now()))) ) order by r.update_time desc, r.id desc limit #{limit}
